title: a16z Podcast: Deep Learning for the Life Sciences

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: with Vijay Pande (@vijaypande) and Bharath Ramsundar Deep learning has arrived in the life sciences: every week, it seems.
reader_summary.overview: with Vijay Pande (@vijaypande) and Bharath Ramsundar Deep learning has arrived in the life sciences: every week, it seems, a new published study comes out... In this episode, a16z General Partner Vijay Pande and Bharath Ramsundar talk about how AI/ML is unlocking the field in a new way. What is it about deep learning's evolution that is allowing it to finally making a major impact in the life sciences?

key_points.text: In this episode, a16z General Partner Vijay Pande and Bharath Ramsundar talk about how AI/ML is unlocking the field in a new way.
What is the practical toolkit you need, the right kinds of problems to attack, and the right questions to ask?
How is the hacker ethos coming to the world of biology?
